differences: Text A's counter target must be a creature you control; Text B's target is any creature (no 'you control' restriction), so B allows putting the counter on an opponent's creature.

Text A's 'modified' count includes only Equipment you control and Auras you control; Text B counts any creature that is equipped (by any Equipment) and does not restrict the Aura to one you control, so B can count creatures A would not.
